$comment: Single source of truth for the POST /intake request contract (E4-SPEC-19). Asserted by tests/test_intake_payload_contract.py (service side) and frontend/app/intake/payload.contract.test.ts (portal side), so either half drifting reddens its own CI job. Synthetic values only — no real or seeded PHI. e5 added submission_id on the request side (E5-SPEC-27): a client-generated UUIDv4 naming the submission ATTEMPT, so a retry of an attempt whose response was lost replays the registration instead of forking a second chart. Additive on the request side only — nothing here is renamed, retyped or removed, and the response side e4 froze is untouched.
